title: The Limits of Post-Selection Generalization
abstract: arXiv:1806.06100v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: While statistics and machine learning offer numerous methods for ensuring generalization, these methods often fail in the presence of adaptivity---the common practice in which the choice of analysis depends on previous interactions with the same dataset. A recent line of work has introduced powerful, general purpose algorithms that ensure post hoc generalization (also called robust or post-selection generalization), which says that, given the output of the algorithm, it is hard to find any statistic for which the data differs significantly from the population it came from.   In this work we show several limitations on the power of algorithms satisfying post hoc generalization. First, we show a tight lower bound on the error of any algorithm that satisfies post hoc generalization and answers adaptively chosen statistical queries, showing a strong barrier to progress in post selection data analysis. translated_abstract: 尽管统计学和机器学习提供了许多确保泛化的方法，但这些方法在存在自适应性的情况下往往会失效——自适应性是指一种常见的做法，即分析方式的选择取决于之前与同一数据集的交互。近期的一系列工作引入了功能强大的通用算法来确保事后泛化（也称为鲁棒泛化或选择后泛化），其含义是：给定算法的输出后，很难找到任何一个统计量使得数据与其来源总体之间存在显著差异。在这项工作中，我们展示了满足事后泛化的算法在能力上的若干局限。首先，我们对任何满足事后泛化并回答自适应选择的统计查询的算法的误差给出了紧的下界，这表明选择后数据分析的进展存在一个强大的障碍。其次，我们证明了事后泛化……
tldr: 本文揭示了事后泛化算法的能力极限，证明了任何满足事后泛化并回答自适应选择统计查询的算法其误差都存在紧的下界，为选择后数据分析的进展设置了一个根本性障碍。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes fundamental limits of post hoc generalization by proving a tight lower bound on the error of any algorithm satisfying post hoc generalization when answering adaptively chosen statistical queries, revealing a strong barrier to progress in post-selection data analysis.
